title: 4 of his first 12 players quit in under 35 seconds
lines: Four of the first twelve people who played his game quit in under thirty-five seconds.
He'd been making it for less than two weeks. A cozy snowplow game.
And a third of his first players were gone before the first driveway was clear.
So he went back through what they did, second by second.
The timer was running before they'd even touched the controls.
So now the clock waits for your first move.
A little hand shows you where to start.
The first three jobs hand out stars more easily.
And your first two continues are free.
Did it work? He doesn't know yet.
So here's the first driveway. Would you have quit?
